unresolved_added: The summary says ALON is most influential while the Relation Distance table later ranks HARARY first; the distinction is not surfaced in the Summary.
Equal coauthor strength ignores paper count, recency, role, and collaboration quality.
Paper significance mixes citations, publication date, and journal influence without a defined formula or collection date.
Movie quality and star popularity are proxied by IMDb rating and Google hits without temporal normalization or validity evidence.
The Erdos1 extraction and Erdos2 removal rules are described informally; no reproducible raw-data parser or retained-author list is supplied.
The source calls the displayed sum of path lengths closeness centrality, but does not invert or otherwise reconcile its direction with the smaller-is-better ideal.
Equal maximum normalization and the ideal vector (1,1,0) impose a compensatory metric choice without weights, sensitivity, or disconnected-node policy.
The top-50 visualization is selected for observability, so it does not show the full 511-node structure or selection uncertainty.
Eigenvector centrality is computed in UCINET without solver settings, matrix version, direction convention, or reproducible output.
The single Harary exception supports a plausible critique of degree but does not validate either ranking against an external outcome.
The power-law statement supplies an exponent but no fit interval, goodness-of-fit statistic, tail threshold, or competing-distribution comparison.
The 24-paper citation network includes eight discovered additions without a search protocol, cutoff date, or complete citation data.
The citation edge direction is chosen for PageRank but its relation to the later matrix convention is not formally audited.
The authors identify three dangling nodes as a failure mode, but the shown update and flow chart do not specify redistribution for them.
Journal impact factor is used as initial paper authority even though it is venue-level, time-varying, and can double count later citation prestige.
The PageRank formula and reported ranks omit iteration count, convergence norm, dangling treatment, numerical trace, and a reproducible matrix.
The authority-popularity diagram uses transformed axes and dashed quadrants without declared cutoffs or uncertainty, so upper-right selection is visual only.
Actor direction relies on leading versus supporting roles, but the data source and rules for ensemble, co-lead, and temporal role assignment are absent.
IMDb ratings are treated as proportional influence-transfer weights without evidence that ratings cause career-network authority.
Google search results are volatile, personalized, locale-dependent, and unversioned, making the popularity comparison irreproducible.
Similarity changes with damping are plotted without an explicit tested range, similarity definition, rank-stability measure, or acceptability threshold.
The stated weakness only says limited data increase error; it gives no sample threshold, uncertainty interval, or repair experiment.
The 80-20 principle is used as network philosophy without verifying a 20 percent share for any presented influence measure.
The proposed shortcut toward influential authors can amplify existing preferential attachment and lacks ethical, access, or outcome safeguards.
Figure 11 is decorative as a strategy sketch: it provides no scale, algorithm, observed example, or decision evaluation.
No source datasets, code, matrix files, software settings, data dates, or machine-readable rankings are released.
